name: Circa
description: A relationship-focused workspace with linked people and companies, saved views, local notes, editable opportunities and safe exports.

notes.layout: Cobalt relationship map, spacious product narrative, linked people and company records, deal pipeline and a working guide
notes.motion: Linked record highlights, saved-view filtering and accessible deal-editor transitions
notes.interaction: Filter records, save views, write scoped notes, edit deal stages and values, inspect linked totals and export selected records or the full workspace
notes.provenance: Seven original pages with four fictional people, three companies and four editable deals, including tested local relationships and export behavior.
